scenario: # Acceptance of V/01.4: a command to a camera without a device — refused (the stand of chapter 2). Format — README.

request: POST /cameras {"name": "door", "source": "driverpack://file/door.mp4"}
@start worker cam w-srv-a-1 on srv-a
@until 60 GET /cameras
POST /requests {"unit": "$c1", "action": "output", "port": 1}
POST /requests {"unit": "$c1", "action": "output"}
@until 30 GET /events?unit=cam/$c1&kind=command.failed
expect: 200 {"events": [{"kind": "command.failed", "of": "cam/1", "outcome": "refused", "action": "output", "error": "camera has no device"}, {"kind": "command.failed", "of": "cam/1", "outcome": "refused", "action": "output", "error": "camera has no device"}]}

request: POST /requests {"unit": "$c1", "action": "output", "port": "@big(33)"}
@manual stub driver describing several video channels (Drivers/Virtual has none): one block on a multichannel device belongs to the ipsrv row for any relatedChannel
@manual block with relatedChannel within channels belongs to the camera with that index; -1 or an index outside channels belongs to ipsrv; no field uses the block index
@manual channel block without a created camera produces no children or warning; a main row without an index appears: block unresolved, rows unchanged, warning
@manual a disabled camera does not change the owner; two rows with one index: smallest id owns it; videos in cam/devices is written on group-row changes without waiting for a description
@manual channel camera can: rays and relays list its child numbers, which need not start at 1; output with port outside this camera's relays is refused «no such output»
@manual owner change: a disabled output stays disabled; enabled: true in the current row settings enables it, the gone row remains
@manual owner changes and children listing is refused: output stays disabled on the next pass with the same set; listing succeeds and related settings are found: output is disabled by those settings
@manual enabled: true on a row, owner changes, enabled: false on the new row, owner returns: output disabled by the later decision; equal or corrupt settings at with conflicting decisions: disabled
@manual stub driver: normal open maps closure to io.input value closed and opening to value open; normal closed maps opening to value closed and closure to value open
@manual disabled sensor: no event, inputs_off grows; unlicensed owner: no event, events_refused grows
@manual driver contact value not translated to open or closed: no event, events_refused grows; the translation is named in the implementation description

@manual stub driver with units (Drivers/Virtual has none; Drivers/OnvifAcfa uses a live controller): cam/device_units rows are created from the root, CreateUnit receives owner and template; editing a row does not restart the connection
@manual template absent from description, parent forms a cycle or maxCount exceeded: units_down says refused; neighbouring units work; unit SignalLost sets lost, Started clears it
@manual unit event: a unit row with unit and event as received, and phase for a two-phase event; a disabled unit writes no events
@manual unit action: performed with reply {action, n, operation}; no such unit, unit is off, no such operation, unit needs n and an operation; an unlicensed row gives camera is not licensed
@manual stub driver with audio: <live_url>/mic is the camera's first mic, /mic/<n> is the device mic; rtpmap uses the device codec; video stream unchanged
@manual mic enabled: false gives DESCRIBE 404; unreadable settings give 404; unlicensed owner gives 404; an open endpoint in each case, and on gone, ends the stream for the client
@manual POST /requests {"unit": "$c", "action": "talk", "port": 1}: performed, device receives Call; another person is refused «busy», the same person gets performed
@manual talk without port, with a foreign port or disabled spk: talk needs a port, no such speaker, speaker is disabled
@manual talk route not opened for 30 s: HangUp and occupancy released; route broken: HangUp; no frame for 8 s without disconnect: HangUp; device hangs up: route closed

@manual stub driver with analytics (Drivers/Virtual has none): cam/device_units type det calls CreateVideoAnalytics with channel and template, then Start; enabled: false calls Stop; event writes a unit row in the camera bucket, det_kind by detector-kinds.tsv; open phase repeats as phase: still every 30 s
@manual detector absent on the channel, conflictDetectors on two enabled rows, or an ipsrv row: units_down refused for the greater n; neighbours continue
@manual camera with one replica and a built-in detector: idle phase, stream not read, events continue

@manual stub driver with PTZ: can.ptz by channel index, absent reference means false; preset_save and preset_clear give performed, reply {action, n}; camera without PTZ gives this device has no telemetry; edit right is on the camera, not the group

@manual cam/ptz_moves row with increasing seq: MoveContinuous, ZoomContinuous, FocusContinuous; deleting the row sets each axis speed to zero; no repeat for PTZ_LEASE means stop; a row found at startup does not move
@manual hung group call (unit Execute, output): camera stop proceeds; hung PTZ call: stop proceeds independently of it
@manual holder SIGKILL during movement: new holder sends stop when taking the epoch; failure-to-stop interval is at most 105 s
